# National Airlines

> > National Airlines operates Boeing 747-400F and Airbus A330 cargo and passenger charter services as part of National Air Cargo Group Inc.

National Airlines provides specialized cargo and passenger charter operations with a modern fleet including B747-400F freighters, B757-200, and A330-200 aircraft. The airline serves global routes including humanitarian relief missions in partnership with organizations like DB Schenker and USAID, with operations based in Anchorage, Chicago, and Orlando.
